in_sanskrit.name: Darunika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of abundance and prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Darunika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Daru means 'a tree' and Nika means 'abundance' or 'prosperity'. Darunika is the name of a goddess who is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is often invoked during Hindu rituals and celebrations to ensure abundance and prosperity.
